dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Hello, welcome to Liyue, and welcome to the Lantern Rite Festival!

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: You must have heard about the music festival held in collaboration with the Iridescence Tour during this year's Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: I hope everyone can have a good time during the festival and enjoy the musical atmosphere.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Of course, for civil matters, please go to the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs.
